max: planning to cut runtime v2.14 + router header-split during tonight's quiet window (01:00 UTC). Canary 5% EU -> 20% US over 30m. Need console pin and API contract signoff. Deploybot queued. Please ack if you own rollback.

lee: ack. I'll own rollback + smoke tests. Quick Q: runtime needs kv-eviction tweak (TTL bump). Does console need schema bump?

sarah: console change is backwards-compatible, just adding optional header. Release notes: 'console: accept router header for shard routing; no data migration.' I'll prepare the blurb. @max can you include the rollout matrix?

nisha: +1 on notes. Also add cost-telemetry flag to the rollout (opt-in) — we agreed to monitor token-cost delta.

deploy-bot: scheduled: runtime v2.14 -> canary (5%) at 01:00 UTC. router header-split enabled on canary. Notifying owners: @lee @sarah @max.

lee: rollback plan: if latency P95 > 350ms or error rate > 0.5% during canary -> immediate abort + unpin. Command: ```/deploy abort runtime v2.14 && /deploy pin runtime v2.13``` Lead: @lee; take point, will post status.

max: noted. console pin requested for 00:50 UTC. @sarah will you pin console schema? I'll update release notes and add the telemetry toggle.

sarah: pin done 00:50 UTC :white_check_mark:. Release notes posted: https://internal/release-notes/6771234567. Will monitor console logs.

deploy-bot: canary started (01:00 UTC) — runtime v2.14 on 5% EU. Telemetry toggle off. Monitoring channels: #runtime-monitor, #router-metrics.

lee: smoke pass on EU canary, p95 280ms, errors 0.08% :thumbsup:. Proceed to 20% US in 15m unless objection.

max: proceed. tagging stakeholders. :shipit:
